scope: Independent standalone-builder and embedded-download serialization receiving; no physics rerun.

expectedControls.expectation: Two builds from identical core, UI, template, checked deck, and guide sources must produce byte-identical HTML. Check mode must accept exact output and refuse stale output without rewriting it. Changing one input must change the appropriate rendered output.

Every required template marker occurs exactly once. Missing or duplicate required markers must refuse the build and preserve any prior output byte-for-byte. Marker names are discovered from the interface after this contract is frozen.
An invalid answer index, malformed JSON, or a structural prerequisite violation must be refused by the native checked-deck path before replacing prior HTML.

Embedded deck and guide payloads retain literal closing script tags, HTML-like text, quotes, ampersands, U+2028 and U+2029 when decoded. Such text must not terminate or inject script elements. Source downloads should retain original source text, including formatting and trailing newline.

The rendered executable script compiles and runs as classic self-contained JavaScript under a minimal authored fixture, with no residual static module imports or exports and no external script src dependency.
An existing output directory containing an authored sentinel must survive a failed file rename intact. The failed build must leave no own temporary output artifact.
Running the actual builder entry point by absolute path from a different working directory uses its own project sources and the intended destination; check mode behaves the same way.

fixtureDesign.isolation: All source mutations and prior-output sentinels live in independently authored fixture directories under /tmp/hamon-normal-modes-builder-review-3e50c5ad22c5.
fixtureDesign.realTemplatePolicy: Use a minimal authored template if the production template is still in flight; retain that scope and later repeat only the rendering/serialization controls against the final production template.

preservation: Original physical/content review packet remains untouched. Actual builder implementation is owned by /root; any proposed fix stays isolated in this new review directory.
